subject: Medford Square Redevelopment
overview: City officials and the Metropolitan Area Planning Council hosted a community meeting to present redevelopment concepts for three city-owned lots in Medford Square and gather feedback on community benefits. Attendees participated in polling and a Q&A session to discuss priorities including parking, affordable housing, retail, and traffic impacts.

items.title: Welcome and Opening Remarks
items.summary: Planning Director Alicia Hunt and Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn welcomed attendees and outlined the goal of establishing community priorities for an upcoming Medford Square RFP.

items.title: Presentation on Development Concepts and Priorities
items.summary: The Metropolitan Area Planning Council presented background research, financial feasibility analysis, and illustrative development scenarios across Lots A, B, and C.

items.title: Breakout Discussions and Mentimeter Polling
items.summary: Attendees participated in brief breakout sessions and an interactive poll to allocate points across various community benefit priorities.

items.title: Public Question and Answer Session
items.summary: Residents expressed preferences for high-quality building design, deep housing affordability, dedicated parking, local retail such as a grocery store, and traffic mitigation.

items.title: Closing Remarks and Next Steps
items.summary: Staff provided details on upcoming drop-in office hours and announced that online survey tools would remain open for additional public feedback.
